_note: Optional. GMGN OpenAPI is used as the fee source for the minTokenFeesSol gate (more accurate than Jupiter's `fees`) and, when screening.useGmgnTrending is on, as a trending-token screening source (/v1/market/rank). Copy to gmgn-config.json and fill apiKey, or set GMGN_API_KEY in .env / gmgnApiKey in user-config.json. Set feeSource to "jupiter" to disable the fee source.
